origin.description: Adds hard wrapping, end padding, and optional tab expansion.
origin.usage: strwrap2_ctl(x, width = 0.9 * getOption("width"), indent = 0, exdent = 0, prefix = "", simplify = TRUE, initial = prefix, wrap.always = FALSE, pad.end = "", strip.spaces = !tabs.as.spaces, tabs.as.spaces = getOption("fansi.tabs.as.spaces", FALSE), tab.stops = getOption("fansi.tab.stops", 8L), warn = getOption("fansi.warn", TRUE), term.cap = getOption("fansi.term.cap", dflt_term_cap()), ctl = "all", normalize = getOption("fansi.normalize", FALSE), carry = getOption("fansi.carry", FALSE), terminate = getOption("fansi.terminate", TRUE))
origin.details: Adds hard wrapping, end padding, and optional tab expansion. An omitted wrap width is 72, which is 0.9 times the default R width of 80.
origin.example: writeLines(strwrap2_ctl("hello how are you today", width=10, pad.end=".", warn=FALSE))

translation.description: Adds hard wrapping, end padding, and optional tab expansion.
translation.usage: strwrap2_ctl(x, width=None, indent=0, exdent=0, prefix="", simplify=True, initial=None, wrap_always=False, pad_end="", strip_spaces=None, tabs_as_spaces=None, tab_stops=None, warn=None, term_cap=None, ctl="all", normalize=None, carry=None, terminate=None)
translation.details: Adds hard wrapping, end padding, and optional tab expansion. An omitted wrap width is 72. A string is one element. None is a missing string. Dotted R names are written with underscores.
